arabic text: Haay Sakina\nEk baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text: Alas, Sakina\nTake me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text: Jhor ker nanne se haatho ko sakina ne kaha\nEk baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text: Joining her tiny hands, Sakina pleaded\nTake me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:
Apni beti ki taraf pyar se dekho baba
Yeh meri akhri quahish hi samaj lo baba
Kuch nahi maagugi phir tumse yeh waada hai mera
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
Look lovingly towards your daughter
Consider this my final wish, Baba
I promise I will ask nothing more of you
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:
Paas beshir ke maqtal mei cheleh jaaou ge
Mujko maaloom hai ab aap nahi aaou ge
Kya yeh mumkin nahi kuch der tehar jaaoy zara
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
You will go to the battlefield beside the infant
I know that you will not return now
Could you not remain for just a little while?
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:
Phool ki tarha sadaa sath hi rakha mujko
Aaj tak aapne tanha nahi chora mujko
Ab muje chor ke kyu jaate ho tanha baba
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
You always kept me beside you like a flower
Until today, you never left me alone
Why do you now leave me in loneliness, Baba?
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:
Tanha medaan mei hargiz nahi jaane dete
Hote gazi to sakina ki sifarish karte
Aap ko waastaa gazi ke keteh shano ka
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
They would never have allowed you to enter the battlefield alone
Had Ghazi been here, he would have pleaded for Sakina
For the sake of Ghazi's severed shoulders
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:
Yeh amaanat na koi cheen le mujse aaker
Saath lejayiyeh baba mere kaano ke gowhar
Apni masoom sakina pe yeh ehsaan hoga
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
May no one come and snatch this trust from me
Take with you, Baba, the earrings from my ears
It would be a kindness to your innocent Sakina
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:
Phir se Qur’an mohabbat ki tilawat karlu
Dil yeh kehta hai ke gi bhar ke ziyaarat karlu
Ab kaha hogi mulaqaat na jaaneh baba
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
Let me recite the Qur'an of love once again
My heart says I should behold you to my heart's content
Who knows when we will meet again, Baba?
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:

Yeh meri akhri quahish hi samaj lo baba
Kuch nahi maagugi phir tumse yeh waada hai mera
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
Look lovingly towards your daughter 
Consider this my final wish, Baba
I promise I will ask nothing more of you
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba

arabic text:
Waqt eh kaash "takallum" jo wahi ruk jaata 
Apneh baba se sakina na kabhi hoti judaa
Phir kabhi aati na masoom laboh se yeh sadaa
Ek baar aur muje godh mei lelo baba
english translation text:
If only time had stopped at that moment, "Taqallum" 
Sakina would never have been separated from her father
These words would never again have left the innocent child's lips
Take me into your lap just once more, Baba
